set.body: Refactor EventModelBuilder into explicit parse, bind, resolve schedule, construct terms, attach contrasts, and assemble stages that return DesignError ADTs instead of relying on a throwing build wrapped by buildEither. Acceptance: public build APIs remain compatible; buildEither returns precise errors for bad durations, subset expressions, hrf_fun shape problems, unknown contrast sets, and unsupported contrast targets.
set.title: Design: stage EventModelBuilder as total compiler
